method.equality: Exact parsed JSON equality. No float tolerance. Keys are unique within every input.
method.cohort: Use each Candidate4 file cohort.start_s and cohort.end_s, inclusive.
method.keep_loss_gate: outcome is reject or spilled. Unresolved is not counted as Keep loss and is reported separately.

transition_definitions.into_loss: left is not a gate loss and Candidate4 is a gate loss
transition_definitions.recovered_loss: left is a gate loss and Candidate4 is not

method.decision_comparison: For Candidate4 associated tracks, compare same numeric track in Candidate2 on class, reject, scheduled, late, and pulse_s.

decision_evidence.limitation: Candidate2 lacks target_uids. Same numeric track comparisons do not prove identical object association.

causal_assessment.baseline: The legacy baseline matches 3,174 of 3,579 Candidate4 Keep samples. Its invalid early scorer and missing target attribution prevent contact or classifier causality.
causal_assessment.candidate2: All 3,579 Candidate4 Keep samples match Candidate2 on the required physical key. Candidate2 and Candidate4 differ in both splitter geometry/material and decision streams.
causal_assessment.raised_top: Eight transitions have no Candidate4 associated rejection and unchanged reported jet-hit count. Six move from Candidate2 Accept to Candidate4 Spill. These support a physical route change, but do not isolate the raised top from friction or unrecorded state.
causal_assessment.decision_changes: Nineteen of 33 transitions map to changed same-numbered track cores. Candidate2 lacks target_uids, so numeric track identity does not prove object association.
causal_assessment.exact_overdue_samples: Overdue traces reproduce exact physical samples independently. Candidate4 resolves all three and removes UID841 opposing contacts. Feed track IDs are not used for this claim.
causal_assessment.conclusion: Existing traces do not isolate the 7.75 mm raised top as the Keep-loss cause. They support decision drift and at least eight physical route shifts.

earlier_candidates.candidate1: Failed native terminal support for four Stone Reject cases.
earlier_candidates.candidate2: Passed the Keep-loss delta gate, but had one mature unresolved object and three active objects past the 1.1 s deadline.
earlier_candidates.candidate3: Failed the Stone route/support gate at 15 of 16.
earlier_candidates.candidate4: Passed physical resolution gates but failed the unchanged Keep-loss delta gate.

bounded_recommendation.release_recommendation: Candidate4 failed the unchanged Keep-loss gate and remains unaccepted. No tested candidate passes every unchanged release gate.
bounded_recommendation.later_work: If sorting resumes, collect paired object-bound decisions, pulse records, initial states, and splitter contacts for the 33 transitions.
bounded_recommendation.attribution_requirement: Separate decision-stream changes from downstream physical routing before selecting another geometry.
bounded_recommendation.candidate_design: Current traces do not justify a new candidate design.
bounded_recommendation.unchanged_gates: Keep every existing release gate unchanged.
